findings.text: Written outside writes: .claude/settings.json — no longer in the diff.
findings.consequence: Nobody is blocked: the branch now touches only declared paths, so a reviewer reading writes: sees the true scope.

findings.text: Missing charter now routes full via Charter.missing(); checks 1-2 fire. scripts/triage.py:60
findings.consequence: A project without a domain pack no longer gets silently routed to the light lane. Work that should have been grilled in full is no longer waved through on absent evidence.

findings.text: File mode overwrites an existing ticket, no exists check. scripts/kanban_ops.py:183
findings.consequence: Anyone re-running the grill on a brief that already has tickets loses that ticket's Log and Findings. Nothing tells them a file was replaced rather than created.

findings.text: partner_facing brief key undocumented; templates/brief.md unchanged. scripts/triage.py:57
findings.consequence: Someone writing a brief for partner-facing work has no way to learn the flag exists. Their brief routes light when it should route full, and no output mentions the flag.
